answer.reason: Both are US multi-state physician-led clinical service providers working with hospitals and health systems and paid through healthcare reimbursement. Pediatrix sells neonatal, maternal-fetal and pediatric physician care, much of it staffed inside hospitals. RadNet runs its own outpatient diagnostic imaging centers. The offerings differ, and the patient groups differ (women, babies and children versus physician-referred imaging patients). The overlap is the healthcare-services setting and the hospital and payer relationships, so this is adjacent.

T:P1.2.text: Led by physicians and trusted by patients, Pediatrix delivers advanced medical solutions across a variety of practice areas around the country.

C:P2.1.text: RadNet | Our Mission. Our Values. - Leading Radiology Forward

C:P2.2.text: RadNet is leading radiology forward by working with our partners to deliver medical imaging services.

C:P2.3.text: RadNet is the national leader in outpatient imaging. Backed by 45+ years of experience, we deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions for all 442 ctr (as of 6/30/26) in our network—and for our strategic partners.

C:P2.4.text: RadNet’s mission — comprehensive radiology solutions — aligns with the future of healthcare.

C:P2.5.text: We are the only radiology provider with the resources to create greater opportunities for our strategic partners. We leverage our national profile and a broad portfolio of clinical and technical services to support best outcomes.

C:P2.6.text: We make it easy for everyone involved in healthcare decisions — administrators, physicians, IT professionals, technologists — to work together. Above all, that includes patients. Recent findings show that patients who are actively involved in their healthcare experience better outcomes and incur lower costs.

C:P2.7.text: Our focus is simple. We deliver high quality, conveniently accessible care in the most cost effective manner possible. Quality, access, and value are at the core of what we do — in every new imaging center we establish, every health system that we partner with, every patient we encounter. That is the RadNet difference.
